req.text: One single heavy stroke on a large barrel drum on a wooden stand, struck with a wooden beater, heard close inside a wooden tower hall: a deep boom with the slap of the skin and a long natural decay ringing in the timber room, no other sounds.

A flock of small birds bursting out of leafy trees all at once: a loud flurry and rush of many wings, branches and leaves shaking and rustling, a few alarmed chirps, then the flock flying off into the distance. Outdoors, close, dry, no music.
